name: 025me5-home-computers
goal: Home hides historical project totals and reports active sessions and heartbeat capacity per computer through the shared Hub and Mac renderers.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Tracker 025me5 controls shared Mac/iPhone and web Home: historic project totals, per-computer running sessions including leases, and existing heartbeat readings on click.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing Hub page matrix covers By project, and the recorded live Home case only checked the remote aggregate. Strengthen both plus the real Mac reader to Hub parser integration.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 604f2e856a: recorded Tracker-to-Hub parser regression fails for missing resource and session data. MB2 one-worker browser confirms expected 2 agents vs 2 remote runs and Nothing open vs 1 done on the actual Hub route; captures saved in artifacts-o7gN0c.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Shared Home pill and read-only dialog use Tracker machine status, reasons and existing capacity readings. Live origin and lease destination runs are deduplicated. Historic project counts remain in the data.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged sorting test and entire test corpus failed at 0257aeca91 and passed at 4baed0db88. Green tree 8e445bce6b77a05239cf2f3062231da8226e8319 is exactly the PR tree at 810b103bac.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Scoped verification at the exact 810b103bac tree: 6 Hub browser cases and 2 desktop/paired-iPhone Project Overview renderer cases passed on an isolated app on harbor-mbp-2, one Chromium worker. Reviewed light and dark captures at desktop and phone width and light tablet. Earlier 16-case base pass covers the original detail and project count change. 81 focused integration/unit tests, lint, Svelte and TS checks, Hub build, unit contracts and deterministic audit passed. Hosted rollout and installed acceptance are pending the release sequence.
